skills.title: Watch a video
skills.summary: Your agent watches a video you point it at and tells you what's in it.
skills.why: A saved video in Cicada is only a title. With this, your agent can look at the frames and captions when you ask, so you can talk about what a video actually says.

network: api.groq.com, only when a video has no captions
api.openai.com, only when a video has no captions
writes: a temporary folder holding the video while it works
hooks: In Claude Code, a short setup check each time a session starts
needs.firstRun: On a Mac it installs ffmpeg and yt-dlp with Homebrew the first time it runs.
limits: Reads English captions; other languages need one of the transcription keys.

terms.summary: It downloads videos with yt-dlp. YouTube's terms don't allow downloading or automated access without YouTube's permission.
safeUses: videos you made, like your own Looms

skills.cicadaNote: Cicada itself never downloads video. It only keeps what your agent tells it afterwards.

skills.title: Look up papers
skills.summary: Your agent searches arXiv, OpenAlex, Crossref and other scholarly sources.
skills.why: When you ask about research, your agent finds the real paper and its link — and can save it to Cicada so it joins your memory.

network: public scholarly services such as arXiv, OpenAlex, Crossref and Semantic Scholar

skills.title: Wispr Flow meetings
skills.summary: Your agent reads the notes Wispr Flow's notetaker took in your meetings.
skills.why: Meetings are conversations with other people. Connecting Wispr Flow lets your agent read a meeting's notes when you ask.

limits: Meetings only — it can't see your dictation history.

skills.cicadaNote: Meetings hold other people's words. Keep only what you'd be comfortable keeping.

skills.title: Granola meetings
skills.summary: Your agent reads your Granola meeting notes.
skills.why: Your agent can look up what was said in a meeting when you ask, instead of you pasting notes in.

accounts: a Granola account; full transcripts need a Granola paid plan

skills.cicadaNote: Meetings hold other people's words. Keep only what you'd be comfortable keeping.

skills.title: Make your own skills
skills.summary: Your agent helps you write, test and tune a skill.
skills.why: Cicada will later turn what it learns about how you work into skills. This is Anthropic's tool for writing and testing them yourself.

skills.title: Read arXiv papers
skills.summary: Your agent searches arXiv and reads a paper's sections.
skills.why: Useful when you read research: your agent can open the paper itself, and save the link to Cicada.

skills.title: Read PDFs
skills.summary: Your agent reads PDFs, pulls out their tables and fills in forms.
skills.why: Handy for the papers and documents you save. Already built into claude.ai's paid plans; this brings it to Claude Code.

limits: Comes as one set with Anthropic's Word, Excel and PowerPoint skills.

skills.cicadaNote: Anthropic's licence doesn't allow copying these files, so Cicada only runs Claude Code's own installer.

skills.title: Review the literature
skills.summary: Your agent runs a careful literature review across several databases.
skills.why: For a research question: your agent gathers papers with checked citations, and can save the ones that matter to Cicada.

skills.title: Transcribe recordings
skills.summary: Your agent turns an audio or video file into text, with who said what.
skills.why: For your own recordings of meetings and calls, so what was said can be kept.
skills.cicadaNote: Recordings hold other people's words. Keep only what you'd be comfortable keeping.
